item.title: Teen shooter who killed 4 at Oregon elementary school was a former student, police say
item.description: Police say a teacher threw her phone at the teenage gunman who killed four people at an Oregon elementary school, then tackled and fought with him

item.title: DOJ reaches settlement with Mississippi police department it found routinely violated civil rights
item.description: The U.S. Department of Justice announced Friday it reached a settlement forcing reforms for a Mississippi city and its police department, which the DOJ found discriminated against Black people, used excessive force and retaliated against critics

item.title: Painting Eisenhower Building would diminish historic character of White House complex, report says
item.description: A draft environmental assessment finds that President Donald Trump's plan to paint a 19th-century landmark office building next to the White House could harm its historic character

item.title: Selma Blair's representatives say she didn't intend to hurt anyone on flight that led to her arrest
item.description: Selma Blair's representatives have stated she did not intend to harm anyone during a recent flight incident

item.title: Kenya confirms third Ebola case, a relative of the first patient who died
item.description: Kenya’s health ministry confirmed that a third person tested positive for Ebola on Friday while in quarantine as a known contact of the first patient, who died two days after arriving from Congo

item.title: FACT FOCUS: Posts falsely claim Democratic Senate candidate James Talarico was at a mental facility
item.description: Republican officials and conservative social media users are spreading unfounded rumors that state Rep. James Talarico, the Democratic nominee in a competitive Texas Senate race, was treated in an Ohio mental health facility last week

item.title: Fed chair Warsh says price stability is key but shies away from signals about rates
item.description: U.S. Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh says he won't prejudge what the U.S. central bank will do about interest rates at its upcoming meetings

item.title: US markets are weighed down by an extended sell-off in the tech sector
item.description: Stocks closed lower on Wall Street as more drops for big tech companies weighed on the market

item.title: Tesla's new Roadster car can thrust itself in the air. But don't expect to drive it anytime soon
item.description: Tesla has unveiled its new Roadster sports car, which can thrust itself in the air, among other engineering bells and whistles

item.title: Presidential adviser says Ukraine is in talks to lift speed limit on military satellite network
item.description: Ukraine is in talks with SpaceX and the Pentagon to lift a speed cap on its military satellite communication service

item.title: Israeli settlers torch cars and trees in West Bank villages, disrupting Palestinians' olive harvest
item.description: Israeli settlers have attacked Palestinian villages across the West Bank

item.title: Norwegian teen sentenced to 20 years in prison for plotting murder in UK for Iran-linked gang
item.description: A Norwegian teenager has been sentenced to 20 years in prison for traveling to Britain to carry out a contract killing for an international crime gang linked to Iran

item.title: Irish public sector workers strike, leading to school closures and canceled medical appointments
item.description: Hundreds of thousands of Irish teachers, doctors and civil servants have walked off the job

item.title: Airstrike kills 3 children in Yemen, and other Middle East developments
item.description: An airstrike has killed three children in Yemen, according to Iranian-backed Houthi rebels
